conclusion: Object +0x0C governs object +0x24 as an array of 12-byte records: the serialized and allocated extent is +0x0C records when (object +0x32 & 0xF000) is zero and three times +0x0C otherwise. Consumer 0x823F5430 uses each retained nested u16 directly, after zero-extension and multiplication by 12, to select one +0x24 record and access three consecutive floats. It does not visibly range-check each selector against +0x0C. This closes the structural retained nested-value domain with the neutral names three-float record array and record selector; semantic vertex or normal meaning, runtime execution, and the remaining Studio Model Viewer gates stay open.
